The woven two-ring mark in the brand's bottle green #123C30, as the app draws it (no knock-outs, so it works on any ground). Geometry (src/lib/brandmark.jsx): viewBox 0 0 40 25; two circles r 8.6, centres (14, 12.5) and (26, 12.5), 12 apart; stroke 2.75, round caps; they cross at (20, 6.339) and (20, 18.661), 45.759° off the horizontal from each centre. Each ring is one arc drawn the long way (large-arc 1, sweep 1) with a gap of 23° (11.5° each side) centred on a crossing: the left ring (#ring-left, M18.651 19.734 A 8.6 8.6 0 1 1 21.108 17.341) breaks at the bottom crossing, where the right ring passes over it; the right ring (#ring-right, M21.349 5.266 A 8.6 8.6 0 1 1 18.892 7.659) breaks at the top crossing, where the left passes over. Each path is 50.583 units long: animate stroke-dasharray 50.583 and stroke-dashoffset from 50.583 to 0 to draw a ring in, left then right, then slide the centres from apart to 12 units to weave them.
